name: Futon or convertible sofa bed
tagline: Two side arms, a seat deck, a back deck, and a hinge mechanism that lets it fold flat.
peopleNote: Two people. The decks are heavy and must be held at an angle while bolted.

tools.why: The arm bolts are often hex-head and under a lot of load.

before: Clear a space the size of the futon fully flat as a bed, not as a sofa. You will need to lay it out to test it.
Identify the seat deck from the back deck now. They are different lengths and the mistake costs a full disassembly.
Keep the mattress rolled and out of the room until the frame is done.
safety: Keep fingers out of the hinge mechanism when converting. These mechanisms close with real force.
Never leave a futon half-converted with children around. The folding action can trap a hand.

steps.title: Lay out the two arms and both decks
steps.say: You have two side arms, a seat deck, a back deck, and the hinge hardware. The seat deck is usually the shorter one. Confirm against the manual before anything else.
do: Two arms, mirror images, often marked L and R
Two decks of slightly different lengths
Hinge arms and barrel bolts in their own bag
steps.watch: Swapping the seat and back decks is the classic futon error. Measure both and check the manual's dimensions.

steps.title: Attach the hinge mechanism to the decks
steps.say: The folding mechanism bolts to the outer rails of both decks. Get all its bolts started loosely, and check the mechanism's pivot points face the right way.
do: Mechanism arms onto the deck rails
All bolts finger-tight
Mirror it exactly on both sides
steps.tip: Photograph the manual's mechanism diagram and keep it on your phone screen while you work. The orientation is genuinely hard to read from a small printed picture.

steps.title: Bolt the seat deck to the arms
steps.say: With a helper holding an arm upright, bolt the seat deck to it. Barrel bolts and washers, finger-tight. Then the other arm.
do: Helper holds the arm vertical
Washer, bolt, hand tight
Repeat on the second arm so the frame stands on its own
steps.watch: An arm let go while only one bolt is in will swing and crack. Keep hold until both bolts are in.

steps.title: Bolt the back deck on
steps.say: The back deck bolts to the mechanism, not directly to the arms. Line up its pivot with the mechanism's slot and bolt it loosely.
do: Line up the pivot bolt first
All bolts started loose
Check the back can swing freely before tightening
steps.tip: If the back cannot swing, the mechanism is on backwards. Check it before you tighten anything — afterwards is a full disassembly.

steps.title: Test the fold before you tighten
steps.say: Convert it from sofa to bed and back, twice, while everything is still loose. This is where you catch a mistake cheaply.
do: Lift the seat deck and push the back down to flat
Pull it back up to sofa position
Do it twice, watching for binding
steps.watch: If it binds or will not go flat, something is mirrored wrong. Fix it now.

steps.title: Tighten everything in sequence
steps.say: With the futon in the sofa position, tighten the arm bolts, then the deck bolts, then the mechanism. Then do a second lap.
do: Sofa position for tightening
Arms, decks, mechanism, in that order
Second lap
steps.tip: Tighten it in the position it will spend most of its life, so the frame settles into that shape.

steps.title: Fit the mattress and strap it down
steps.say: Unroll the mattress onto the deck and use the straps or ties to hold it. Unstrapped futon mattresses slide off every time you convert.
do: Unroll on the deck in bed position
Thread the straps around the deck slats
Snug, not crushing the mattress
steps.tip: A new futon mattress needs a day or two to finish expanding. It will feel firm and look thin at first.

steps.title: Convert it ten times
steps.say: Work the mechanism ten times. It will loosen up and you will catch any bolt that needed another turn.
do: Sofa to bed and back, repeatedly
Listen for knocks
Retighten anything that moved
steps.tip: New mechanisms are stiff. Ten cycles and it will feel like the showroom model.

steps.title: Protect the floor and the wall
steps.say: Felt pads under the feet, and leave a few inches from the wall. A futon moves backwards every time someone sits down heavily.
do: Felt pads on hard floors
A few inches of clearance behind
Check the back clears the wall in bed position
steps.watch: Measure the footprint in bed position. Futons grow by a foot or more when flat and that often means moving it away from a wall.

fixes.a: The mechanism is almost certainly mirrored wrong on one side, or the back deck is in the seat position. Loosen everything and compare both sides against the manual photo.

fixes.q: One side folds and the other sticks
fixes.a: The two mechanisms are at slightly different positions on the deck rails. Loosen both, align them by measuring from the same end, and retighten.
Barrel bolts have settled. A full tightening lap in the sofa position fixes most of it. Felt or nylon washers at the pivot points kill the rest.

fixes.q: The mattress slides off when I convert it
fixes.a: Use the straps. If none came, luggage straps or heavy-duty velcro ties around the deck slats work perfectly.

fixes.q: A bolt is too short to reach
fixes.a: You have a bolt from the wrong bag, or the frame needs loosening elsewhere so it can shuffle. Loosen everything, let the frame find its shape, then try again.
